$comment: Severity overrides + module assignments. Edit any 'severity' field; the dashboard will recompute health on next render. UI overrides also persist per-browser via localStorage.
$modulesComment: Pinned module list = the in-app top-nav modules + Login (pre-auth). These always render on the dashboard, even with 0 tests / 0 bugs. Bugs auto-route to their `module` field; tests auto-route by spec folder name.
$bugsComment: Each bug carries: severity, module (one of the pinned modules), title, plus traceability fields — `test` (Playwright spec path), `testName` (exact title of the surfacing test inside that file, prefixed with the K-bug ID so we can correlate a failure on the dashboard back to the bug), and `manualTC` (Manual/testplan TC ID, null if none). `unverified: true` flags bugs whose original report needs re-verification before next push.
